Name: Money Sinks - Dark Offerings
Author: Nullnnow
Description:
[size=4][b]Description[/b][/size]
A new shrine is added to the game that lets you purchase and upgrade 6 new powers! The shrine can be found in 
[spoiler]either Lewis' basement or the witch's hut, depending on your settings (note: to enter Lewis' basement you need to place a set of stairs in his bedroom).[/spoiler]
and can only be activated once you've obtained mastery experience.

[size=4][b]Main features[/b][/size]
[color=#D4D4D8][size=3]6 Brand new powers! [/size][/color]
[list]
[*][color=#D4D4D8][size=3][b]Crop P[/b][/size][/color][color=#D4D4D8][size=3][b]ower.[/b] Increases the minimum quality of harvested crops. This quality ranges from silver to iridium, depending on the the level of this power (maxes out at level 3).[/size][/color][/*]
[*][color=#D4D4D8][size=3][b]Animal Power.[/b] Grants animals a chance not to need to eat at the start of the day. This chance ranges from 25% to 100%, depending on the level of this power (maxes out at level 4).[/size][/color][/*]
[*][color=#D4D4D8][size=3][b]Fruit Tree Power.[/b] Increases the minimum quality of fruits from fruit trees. This quality ranges from silver to iridium, depending on the the level of this power (maxes out at level 3). [/size][/color][/*]
[*][color=#D4D4D8][size=3][b]Fish Power.[/b] Increases the minimum quality of fish obtained from fishing and crabpots. This quality ranges from silver to iridium, depending on the the level of this power (maxes out at level 3). [/size][/color][/*]
[*][color=#D4D4D8][size=3][b]Crabpot Power.[/b] Gives crabpots a chance to catch more items (maxes out at level 4).[/size][/color][/*]
[*][color=#D4D4D8][size=3][b]Luck Power.[/b] Each level increases your daily luck by a small amount (maxes out at level 3).[/size][/color][/*]
[/list][list]
[*][size=3]A means of purchasing golden animal crackers and Qi gems.[/size][/*]
[*][size=3]3 Different styles for the shop added by this mod.[/size][/*]
[*][size=3]An option for cheaper item [/size]prices.[/*]
[/list]
[size=4][b]Compatibility[/b][/size]
This mod should be fully compatible with the following mods:
[list]
[*]Alecto the Witch[/*]
[*]Distant Lands - Witch Swamp Overhaul[/*]
[/list][b][size=4]Books[/size][/b]
An add-on to this mod, [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/46024?published=1]Money Sinks - Books for Dark Offerings[/url], has been released! It adds several new books for sale, with more to come in the future!

[size=4][b]Future Plans[/b][/size]
[color=#D4D4D8][size=3]I'd like to add books to the shop. I also want to eventually add compatibility with [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/23697?tab=description]Mastery Extended[/url], with each power also costing a mastery level.[/size][/color]

[color=#D4D4D8][size=3]Want more mods to spend large sums of money in? Then check out the other mods in the Money Sinks series of mods![/size][/color]
[list]
[*][color=#D4D4D8][size=3][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/44966]Money Sinks - Golden Statues[/url][/size][/color][/*]
[/list]

Manifest.Name: (CP) Money Sinks - Dark Offerings
Manifest.Description: A mysterious entity offers great power, for the right price. This is the second entry in my Money Sinks series of mods, a series of mods that aims to add more ways of spending large sums of money in Stardew! This mod offers several new powers that you can purchase, alongside a few other treats and goodies.
